role: Converts utterances to primitive activation patterns via graph lookup (no LLM at runtime).
detail: Implements CANON A.12 (no NLP in cognition path) and Phase 3 conversation engine design. SymbolicDecomposer class queries MEANS edges from WordNodes to PrimitiveSymbolNodes, computes activation as confidence*weight per edge, and aggregates via max-pooling across words. DecompositionResult dataclass captures per-word activations, aggregate activation dict, epistemic gaps (ungrounded words), comprehension_ratio, dominant_primitives (activation>=0.3), and missing_primitives (0.0 activation). WordActivation dataclass holds single-word primitive activation pattern with is_grounded boolean. Helper format_activation_summary() generates compact inner-register logging. Cold-start behavior expected: before grounding_maintenance.py seeds MEANS edges, all words are epistemic gaps (infant state by design).
gotchas: Cold-start epistemic gaps expected before grounding_maintenance runs; if all words are gaps check that MEANS edges exist and edge.properties has 'weight' key; edge query silently returns empty dict on exception (line 252-256) rather than propagating; aggregation uses max-pooling per primitive not sum (line 184-186); dominant_primitives threshold is hardcoded 0.3 (line 200); no validation that word_node_id format matches graph node convention; no special handling for punctuation-only tokens post-strip (filtered on line 161)
